
```{r}
#| label: __CHUNKLABEL__
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4
if (!exists("spec") || is.null(spec) || nrow(spec) == 0) {
  cat("\n*No spectra export accompanied this file, so the spectra cannot be shown.*\n\n")
} else {
  chans <- dat %>% filter(window == "__WINDOW_R__") %>% distinct(channel) %>% pull(channel)
  sw <- spec %>% filter(channel %in% chans, bin %in% c(__BINVECTOR_R__))

  # The frequencies this window actually tested. A spectral export names
  # them in its own window column (a label such as "10Hz"), but the
  # numeric value lives in the measurements, so it is read from there.
  marks <- dat %>% filter(window == "__WINDOW_R__") %>%
           summarise(f = suppressWarnings(unique(frequency_hz))) %>% pull(f)
  marks <- marks[is.finite(marks)]

  if (nrow(sw) == 0) {
    cat("\n*The spectra export has no matching channels or bins for this window.*\n\n")
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(sw, aes(x = frequency_hz, y = amplitude, colour = bin))
    if (length(marks) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = marks, linetype = "dashed",
                          colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.4)
    }
    p <- p +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
      facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y") +
      labs(x = "frequency (Hz)", y = "evoked amplitude", colour = "condition") +
      alz_theme()
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")

    if (length(marks) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("Tested at %s Hz.\n\n", paste(format(marks, trim = TRUE), collapse = ", ")))
    }
  }
}
```
